name: @ezxomp/gsd-loop
description: Autonomous GSD loop kernel for OMP (port of gsd-pi auto-mode loop)

loop.maxIterations.description: Hard iteration cap per run — runaway protection (gsd-pi MAX_LOOP_ITERATIONS)

loop.memoryHeapThresholdRatio.description: Heap used/limit ratio that triggers a graceful stop (gsd-pi memory threshold)

loop.maxConsecutiveErrors.description: Consecutive errors before a hard stop (gsd-pi error-ladder strikes)

loop.maxCooldownRetries.description: Consecutive rate-limit cooldowns before stopping (gsd-pi MAX_COOLDOWN_RETRIES)

loop.cooldownFallbackWaitMs.description: Fallback cooldown wait in ms (gsd-pi COOLDOWN_FALLBACK_WAIT_MS)

loop.maxFinalizeTimeouts.description: Consecutive finalize timeouts before auto-pause (gsd-pi MAX_FINALIZE_TIMEOUTS)

verify.timeoutMs.description: Verification command timeout in ms (gsd-pi verification_timeout_ms)
